review.notes: All 22 bilingual entries read in full. Native Harvey template takes each of twelve condition labels; Greek accusative articles follow για consistently. Generic προϊόν/αντικείμενο wrappers make item references grammatical. Five placement suffixes compose with βάλω, and the native non-edible branch confirms their object context. Names checked against glossary; source request details preserved.
